description: Add tests for source_reputation and hydrators modules - 140 lines at 0% coverage. Tests domain normalization, blacklist/whitelist logic, auto-blacklist check, score adjustments, and hydrator metadata enrichment.
steps: Test load_source_lists: reads blacklist/whitelist from a temp config.yaml (create a fixture with tmp_path writing a config.yaml with sources section)
Test is_blacklisted / is_whitelisted with config fixture

Test check_auto_blacklist: mock query_by_domain to return low scores, verify returns True when avg <= max_avg_score and count >= min_articles, returns False otherwise, returns False when disabled in config

Test get_source_adjustment: returns negative penalty for blacklisted domain, returns positive boost for whitelisted domain, returns (0, '') for normal domain, returns (-20, '..') for auto-blacklisted domain

Test hydrate_source_reputation: mock query_by_domain, verify it extracts domain from ctx.content.source_url, computes average, returns dict with source_domain, source_reputation, source_article_count. Test with no source_url returns None values.

Test hydrate_article_stats: test with sample text containing URLs, paragraphs, markdown images. Verify char_count, paragraph_count, link_count, image_references, avg_sentence_length, has_links are computed correctly. Test with empty text returns zeros.
acceptance_criteria: All tests in tests/test_source_reputation.py and tests/test_hydrators.py pass
